epoch_zero: diagnostic only, excluded from checkpoint selection as in B
primary_change: zero output weights and bias=-inner_target_mean/inner_target_scale; target remains unchanged

loss_evidence.source: replay of 18 original B seed42 checkpoints on their own inner training subsets, no new training
loss_evidence.interpretation: concentrated squared errors justify one robust-loss comparison, not discarding real crisis observations

selection.score: mean MAE/persistence MAE over six blocks x three horizons with equal cell weight
selection.initial_rule: seed42 gates against B; at most one passing variant per architecture, lowest score, tie C
selection.stability_rule: reuse seed42, add123/2026 only to selected candidate; same gate on means and each seed score below paired B
selection.fallback: retain B when no candidate passes, never choose a best seed or backfill a second candidate
